offering_description.value: Provides a single cloud-based human capital management software platform covering payroll, talent acquisition, time and labor, benefits administration and HR management. Sells to employers, mainly mid-sized and larger US businesses, through a direct sales force and delivers the software as a subscription.

primary_products.value: cloud HCM software; payroll software; time and attendance software; talent management software; benefits administration software

primary_services.value: payroll processing; employee self-service support; implementation and customer support; tax filing services

customer_segment.value: B2B: US employers of various sizes needing payroll and HR management, mainly small to large businesses

end_markets.value: human resources and payroll across many industries; healthcare; retail; manufacturing; professional services

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring per-employee fees for use of the HCM and payroll platform; service fees: implementation fees and interest on client funds held for payroll tax

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and hosts its own cloud HCM software, sold to employers

geography_served.value: US national: Clients across the United States with offices in several states, small presence in Canada or elsewhere is uncertain

specialization.value: related lines: payroll, talent acquisition, time and labor, benefits and HR modules on one platform

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales representatives selling to employers through regional offices

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payroll tax filing and handling client funds under IRS and state tax rules, plus data privacy and employment laws

notes: Geography beyond the US is uncertain.
